surveys.title: Afghanistan National Nutrition SMART Survey 2022
surveys.lead_org: Afghanistan Nutrition Cluster partners (technical support: Action Against Hunger Canada)
surveys.coverage: National, 34 strata (provinces; Kabul split into Rural and Urban). Faryab missing from anthropometry tables; no mortality data for Badghis, Faryab, Ghor
surveys.notes: Final report April 2023. Data collected province by province, February to October 2022. Provincial anthropometry from Annex II (6-59 months); combined GAM/SAM from Table 15 (titled 0-59 months). National mortality excludes Badghis, Ghor, Faryab. Several typing errors in provincial tables (see Notes).

surveys.title: Enquête nutritionnelle anthropométrique et de mortalité rétrospective SMART 2022
surveys.coverage: National, 11 regions + Bamako; plus Rapid SMART in IDP sites (Ségou, Mopti, Gao, Bamako)
surveys.recall_period: 90 days from 26 March 2022 (methodology); section 4.3 says about 108 days
surveys.notes: Final report dated 28 November 2022. IDP sites covered by a Rapid SMART component (population group = IDPs in sites). Recall period stated inconsistently in the report.

surveys.title: Enquête nutritionnelle nationale SMART 2021
surveys.lead_org: Institut National de la Statistique (INS) / Direction de la Nutrition
surveys.coverage: National, 8 regions; Tahoua region surveyed by department (11 strata)
surveys.notes: Tahoua region results are weighted from its 11 departments. Department names as printed (MADADOUA in Tableau XIX = Madaoua).

surveys.title: Integrated Nutrition SMART Survey, Borno State (MMC, Jere, Konduga LGAs)
surveys.coverage: 3 LGAs of Borno State surveyed separately (MMC, Jere, Konduga); Mafa LGA cancelled (floods)
surveys.notes: Funded by BHA/USAID and LDSC. Konduga anthropometry rejected (high SD): only a recalculated GAM (SD = 1) is given. WHZ table covers children 0-59 months (WHZ/WLZ).

surveys.title: Integrated Nutrition and Mortality SMART Survey: Afmadow, Badhan, Caynabo, Lasacanood and Qardho districts
